records.footnote: Net weighted balance' is the difference between the weighted percentages of 'ups' and 'downs'.  A positive value indicates a net upward trend and a negative value denotes a net downward trend.  Link to latest BES release is available via www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/search-by-theme/industry/business-expectations/latest-data .
